title: Green shakshuka with spinach and feta
steps: Slice the leek finely, dice the courgette and chop the garlic.
Soften them in the oil for 5 minutes and add the cumin.
Add the spinach in batches, let it wilt and season with salt.
Make four hollows, crack in the eggs and cook covered for 5–7 minutes until set.
Serve with feta and yoghurt, with pitta on the side.
